events.label: Skynet sends T-1000 to 1991
events.description: In the future war's last act, Skynet sends a terminator - the liquid-metal T-1000 - back to 1991 to kill John Connor as a boy.

events.label: Resistance sends reprogrammed T-800
events.description: The human resistance captures the time vault and answers with the same move in reverse: a reprogrammed T-800, the machine that once hunted Sarah, sent back to protect her son.

events.label: T-1000 arrives 1991
events.description: The T-1000 arrives naked in a street of fire - and takes its first human shape from a passing policeman.

events.label: T-800 arrives 1991
events.description: The T-800 arrives in the same weekend, acquires leathers and a shotgun, and sets out to find the boy first.

events.label: T-800 rescues John from T-1000
events.description: The T-800 rescues John from the T-1000 in a shopping-mall chase - the killing machine becoming, step by step, the boy's guardian.

events.label: Sarah broken out of Pescadero
events.description: John learns his mother is locked in the Pescadero mental hospital, and the machines spring her - Sarah Connor fighting out of the ward that wants her silent.

events.label: Dyson allies; Cyberdyne raid planned
events.description: Sarah tracks the future's roots to Miles Dyson, the Cyberdyne engineer building the chip that becomes Skynet - and, wounded and reluctant, he comes to understand what his work will do.

events.label: Cyberdyne destroyed; chip/arm melted
events.description: They raid Cyberdyne, destroy the research, and melt the recovered chip and robot arm - striking Judgment Day off the calendar at its root.

events.label: Hoped fork: Judgment Day averted
events.description: The hoped-for fork: no chip, no Skynet, no war - the future they came from quietly cancelled by the people who would have suffered it.

events.label: T-1000 destroyed; T-800 self-terminates
events.description: The T-1000 is finally destroyed in a steel mill's molten metal - and the T-800, having done his job, lowers himself into the same fire.

events.label: Open road — uncertain future
events.description: Sarah drives the open road with the boy she has learned to mother again, the future unwritten - hopeful, and watchful.

events.label: T-800 sent to protect John
events.description: The reprogrammed machine is sent to stand between John and Skynet's assassin.

events.label: T-1000 sent to kill John
events.description: The T-1000 comes for the boy who will one day lead humanity.

events.label: Sarah in Pescadero
events.description: Sarah, disbelieved and committed, arms herself in her mind while the system calls her mad.

events.label: Rescue Sarah; escape
events.description: The escape from Pescadero - mother, son and machine reunited on the run.

events.label: Find Miles Dyson
events.description: Finding Miles Dyson - the gentle man whose evening research will one day end the world.

events.label: Destroy Cyberdyne lab
events.description: The Cyberdyne raid - police, gunfire, and the office where the future was being invented.

events.label: Highway / steel mill chase
events.description: The chase to the steel mill - truck, Harley, and liquid nitrogen.

events.label: T-1000 destroyed in molten steel
events.description: The liquid metal assassin breaks apart and sinks, still reaching, in the mill's fire.

events.label: T-800 lowers into steel to remove chip/arm future
events.description: The T-800's last act: lowering itself into the molten steel to make sure its own chip can never start the war it was built to prevent.

events.label: Sarah hope for future without Judgment Day
events.description: Sarah's closing words: if a machine can learn the value of human life, maybe the future isn't written after all.

events.label: Future war still threatened but deferred
events.description: The asterisk the film leaves: the war is only deferred - the storm clouds on the road ahead are a warning, not a promise.

ruleEffects.effect: Destroying origin tech attempts overwrite of Judgment Day
Creates hoped no-JD branch rather than guaranteed single rewrite

interventions.notes: Franchise later re-forks; T2 ending is hopeful overwrite/branch tension

outcome.summary: Present-day destruction of Skynet seed tech; T-800 sacrifice; Judgment Day postponed/uncertain rather than sealed closed loop.
